judge_edits.to: 阿拉伯湾地区通行的叫法
judge_edits.why: Source: "a general Gulf name" / اسم خليجي عام: a name current across the Gulf region, not on the water. 阿拉伯湾通行 reads as current on the sea itself; the region form 阿拉伯湾地区 (BRIEF form list) restores the old 海湾 region sense.
Gulf cooking is cuisine of the region; a sea name before 菜肴 reads as seafood of the Arabian Gulf. The 05 note itself announces 阿拉伯湾地区菜肴 but the text dropped 地区; aligns with zh-47 (沙特和阿拉伯湾地区的菜肴).
Same as zh-24 (note/text mismatch in 05; region form for cuisine).
Same as zh-24; this events.ts line repeats the hasawi-lomi blog sentence, so the three cuisine positions now read identically.

rulings.title: Mitigation for the unfamiliar 阿拉伯湾 (blind finding 1)
rulings.ruling: No locator is added in this batch. The sea-sense first mentions already sit next to a location on their page: 沙特阿拉伯东部沿海 (al-uqair zh-1, 48-hours zh-20, worth-visiting zh-27, home chapter title beside zh-40) or 哈萨以东 (zh-3/4, zh-14..17, uqair-beach, salwa 距胡富夫约150公里). This is the context the reader used to resolve the name. The remaining positions are region forms (阿拉伯湾地区/国家/地区菜肴), which cannot be confused with the Red Sea or Arabian Sea in use. The two context-free UI leads (home.feat.lead zh-52, list.lead zh-54) render a source that gives no location; adding 沙特阿拉伯东部 there would add words the source sentence lacks and exceed the narrow mandate. Recorded for the owner as an optional follow-up.
rulings.precedent: ru P8 and tr Kare: a name collision inherent in an owner ruling is accepted, and the mitigation is the context already present, not a new gloss. owner-rulings-1023: the mandate is the ruled expression only.

rulings.title: 海湾路 beside 阿拉伯湾 (blind finding 4)
rulings.ruling: 海湾路 stays. It is the established proper name of the Hofuf road (طريق الخليج, termbase 海湾路; also 海湾路（卡塔尔路）), and the BRIEF lists it explicitly as excepted. That the same water appears under two names is the normal situation of a street name, and the street is far from the sea; renaming it 阿拉伯湾路 would invent a name nobody uses. No change.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF exceptions; de Al-Khaleej-Straße / ru Эль-Халидж keep the street as a proper name.

rulings.title: 海湾阿拉伯国家 → 阿拉伯湾国家 (zh-38, zh-46; proposer uncertainty)
rulings.ruling: Upheld. 阿拉伯湾阿拉伯国家 would double 阿拉伯 and read as an error; 阿拉伯湾国家 renders Arab Gulf states / دول الخليج العربي with the ruled name and the same form as zh-41..45 (Gulf states). The Arab sense is carried by the ruled name itself.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF form list (阿拉伯湾国家); termbase 685 (海湾国家 / 海湾阿拉伯国家) collapses to one form.

rulings.title: Cuisine wording (zh-24, zh-25, zh-39; proposer uncertainty)
rulings.ruling: Region form 阿拉伯湾地区菜肴 / 阿拉伯湾地区的菜肴, as the 05 notes intended and as zh-47 already has. A bare sea name before 菜肴 suggests seafood from the water. The added 地区 is part of the Gulf expression (BRIEF lists 阿拉伯湾地区), so it is within the mandate.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF form list; termbase 23 (the Gulf region = 海湾地区, now 阿拉伯湾地区).

rulings.title: 阿拉伯湾经济协议 (zh-46)
rulings.ruling: Upheld. The zh text is a descriptive rendering of الاتفاقية الاقتصادية الخليجية / the Gulf economic agreement, not an official organisation name like 海湾合作委员会, so the ruling applies. The reader asked which agreement this is and which country 本国产品 means. That vagueness is in the source and predates this batch, so it is out of scope.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF: only official organisation names are excepted.

rulings.title: Fixed-string termbase entries carrying 海湾
rulings.ruling: The ruling overrides the frozen strings: 海湾地区最大的水域之一 (terms.563) becomes 阿拉伯湾地区最大的水域之一 (zh-6, zh-48), and the chandal gloss (terms.239) becomes 尚达尔木杆（chandal，阿拉伯湾传统建筑常用的进口木料） (zh-7, zh-10). The gloss wording is otherwise unchanged.
rulings.precedent: O-GULF supersedes P5 (neutral 海湾) and every entry derived from it.
